meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会当上一支 5 人对抗团队的 Lead:成员互相攻击彼此的发现,它只挑出扛住攻击的洞见,再交给专职规划者正式成文。开始时它会先说 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严格度,或你要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批评式规划时触发;前提是 omo-senpi 团队工具可用,且当前是顶层 lead 会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个功能
say.note: 它会召集 5 人对抗团队互攻后再定稿

say.text: 对这份方案跑一次交叉批评
say.note: 5 名成员各自开火,只留站得住的洞见

say.text: 这是我的需求,先让对抗团队审一遍再出计划
say.note: 最后由专职规划者正式成文

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team: members attack each other's findings, it keeps only the defensible insights, then hands them to a dedicated planner to formalize. It first announces HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning needs maximum rigor, or the user asks for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires the omo-senpi team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this feature.
say_en.note: It gathers a 5-member adversarial team, then formalizes what survives.

say_en.text: Run a cross-critique pass on this plan.
say_en.note: Five members attack it before a planner rewrites it.

say_en.text: Here's my requirement — let the adversarial team review it first.
say_en.note: Then a dedicated planner produces the final plan.
